name: Lily
source:
Technical officer from the Republic, Captain of the Stream Airship Rosebud, that's me!

I came to do a demo stream of the engagement announcement at [url=/c156156]Prince Gwyn[/url]'s request.

Now everyone thinks I had something to do with the fires in The City...

[From Digital Artwork book]
